input: Unchanged full raw Moonstone256x256 elevation(m) and slope(degree), fixed Train5135/Val1155 cohort
transform: No resize, crop, interpolation, reprojection, flips, augmentation or filtering; normalization from unchanged audited NASA YAML only
nasa_dataset_transform: Not applied. UntokLunarTransform inherits pre_resize512 then normalization, followed by crop and flip. This downstream protocol preserves Moonstone tiles instead.
pairing: Same policy, raw inputs, normalization, cohort, head/adapters, order, optimizer, stopping and selection budgets for random and pretrained; only encoder initialization differs.
selection: Explicit --spatial-policy moonstone_native256_v1 required for preflight, lock, run and replay; default strict_config_v1 still rejects pre_resize mismatch.
execution_gates_unchanged: Audited real source and finite-sentinel provenance
Compatible private Python/ROCm/runtime; no shared environment replacement
Fixed checkpoint size/hash plus complete selected inference keys/shapes before state loading
Actual paired forward/backward with same device, adaptation and policy
Full unchanged Train/Val scan and actual budget lock before task scores
scientific_boundary: Exploratory Moonstone-native-grid transfer, not NASA preprocessing/physical-scale equivalence or established transfer benefit. No new scores exist.

source_evidence.embedding: ni_lfm/models/encoder_embeddings.py: ImageEncoderEmbedding builds256/16 positions and uses them directly at matching geometry; strict audit is necessary before upstream loading, which otherwise supports interpolation.
source_evidence.factory: ni_lfm/models/lfm_utils.py: init_enc_dec_embeddings and _instantiate_embedding pass input_size and patch_size, not pre_resize.
source_evidence.transforms: ni_lfm/data/modality_transforms.py: pre_resize is a dataset operation, distinct from model input size.
